entries.0aa9d0020046b97b: This business operates theme parks. For the fiscal year ended July 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥8,948 million. Consolidated subsidiary Nihon Theme Park Kaihatsu Co., Ltd. and others operate amusement parks where families, older people and people with dogs can spend time safely, and also carry out villa management on commission, lodging and restaurant operations. From March 2026, Izu Kanko Kaihatsu Co., Ltd. has joined, and operation of Amagi Tokyu Resort has also begun.

It is working, with a medium- to long-term perspective, to revitalize ski resorts that have struggled financially, as assets for revitalizing regional economies.
